cases.note: P4.130 (P4.D228's NIT re-premised): a trail element v4's RouteAttemptSchema refuses (a non-uuid profileId) makes v4's getMessages SKIP the TOOL message, so the route answers 404 `Tool message not found` before any trail code — v5 had kept the row (its lenient reader checks no uuid)
